column1: # Exact policy for every replayed path outside arch/arm64/um and arch/um.

column6: rationale
ARCH=um with SUBARCH=arm64 requires the architecture selection and generated-header wiring at this base-owned path.

Disable atomic scanout before unplugging Virtio-GPU at system shutdown so the final framebuffer GEM mapping cannot outlive the DRM VMA manager; drop the local topic when the selected base contains an equivalent ordering fix.
Allocate standard host-visible Virtio-GPU blobs at the 16 KiB Apple VM granule so 4 KiB guest subpages share one coherent imported host allocation without aliasing or a private userspace ABI.
Let fbcon own the standard VT major on UML configurations that deliberately disable the legacy stdio console driver.
Poll Darwin's cooperative timer at the scheduler's central lock-free cond_resched boundary before testing whether the expired deadline requested rescheduling.
Independent zero-length cachestat range correction required by the port's guest workload; keep it isolated so this local line can drop it when contained.
Let an architecture whose synchronous range invalidation serializes every executor retain precise nested mmu-gather ranges instead of forcing a generation-wide flush.
Use Perl for Darwin's in-place trailing-NUL trim while retaining the existing sed command on Linux hosts.
Avoid Linux-only linker options when the kernel host is Darwin.
Temporarily rename Linux's device-table uuid_t while Darwin system headers expose their own type.
Independent connected-stream sendmsg socket lookup correction exercised by SMP UML; keep it isolated so this local line can drop it when contained.
